title: One-Goal Heartbreaker: Rink Ratz Edge Cobras 4–3 12/11/25
description:
Globo Gym King Cobras D vs. Rink Ratz — Game #4937
Final Score: Rink Ratz 4 – Cobras 3
Date: 12/11/25 • League: BH Adult D
Location: Baptist Health Iceplex Rink 2
